title: Michaels Lyric delivers heart and purpose with new single "October Rain"
htmlContent:
Hailing from the vibrant artist community of San Francisco, Michaels Lyric sets us on a new journey with his latest single, "October Rain." Produced in England, this one captures influences by melding introspective storytelling with the timeless sounds synonymous with British legends like Oasis.

Inspired by a book called Michaels Lyric, the lyrics to the song possess a literary depth that is both lyrically personal and poetic. Every line speaks of an intimate diary, where the subtle weight of times past finds its place, and also where the moving beauty of life's achievements belongs. "October Rain" conjures up the dreamy grandeur of Wonderwall with stature and musical depth that may be likened to Champagne Supernova, maintaining a unique world truthfulness and sound native to Michaels Lyric.

https://open.spotify.com/track/0TRyrIJ44nCOUhub6wA7S1

"October Rain" carries an intentional identity, and Michaels Lyric has pledged all streaming royalties to Slice Out Hunger through DistroKid's Artists For Change initiative, transforming his creativity into a direct aid for those in need. "October Rain" is a moment of meditation within the melodic, intentional, and emotive commitment to sound. When concluding notes fade, it's as if you are left with the faint echo of rain and a reminder that music, at its best, is capable of both inspiring and bringing about change.
